definitions.explanation: The lowest rank in the Japanese police force; a patrol officer or beat cop.

examples.japanese: {巡査|じゅんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えてくれた→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: A police officer at the police box gave me directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}して→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧{巡査|じゅんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He graduated from the police academy and became a constable.

examples.japanese: {巡査|じゅんさ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{巡査|じゅんさ}⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}した→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧。
examples.english: He was promoted from constable to sergeant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{巡査|じゅんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パトロール→パトロール：11591_patorooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A young constable was patrolling the neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧{巡査|じゅんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いていた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The constable who rushed to the accident scene was taking statements from witnesses.

notes:
{巡査|じゅんさ} is the entry-level rank in the Japanese police force. The term is somewhat formal and older; in everyday speech, ⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧ (police officer) or ⟦お{巡|まわ}りさん→おまわりさん：02896_omawarisan⟧ (informal, friendly term for police officer) are more commonly used.

POLICE RANKS (ascending):
- {巡査|じゅんさ}: constable (lowest rank)
- {巡査|じゅんさ}⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧: sergeant
- {巡査|じゅんさ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: senior sergeant
- ⟦{警部|けいぶ}→警部：24547_keibu⟧⟦{補|ほ}→〜補：noentry⟧: assistant inspector
- ⟦{警部|けいぶ}→警部：24547_keibu⟧: inspector

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧: police officer (general term)
- ⟦お{巡|まわ}りさん→おまわりさん：02896_omawarisan⟧: police officer (friendly, colloquial)
